title: Hanasato Minori — Beyond The Spotlight〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few days before the solo show

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Another exhausting day...!
I'll probably fall asleep if I close my eyes right now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Just a little bit more to go until our show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have to do my best and make sure I spread hope to everyone who attends!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I should feel really refreshed after taking a nice, relaxing bath!!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: I heard you shout! What happened?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-My pinky... I jammed it and...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Brother
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. Just try to be more careful, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Hey! You could show a little more compassion...!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
Your show's in a few days, so you really do need to be more careful. Here, let me take a look.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...
But it should be fine as long as I ice it.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, that appears to be the case.
Then, make sure to do just that after you've taken your bath.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness it wasn't anything serious. You really do seem to have no manner of luck when it comes to these sorts of situations, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line:
At the same time...
Why is it that you seem to be more unlucky than the rest of us?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, that's easy.
She takes after you, honey. I mean, you can be so careless sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line:
Me?
I say she got it from you, dear.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line:
Minori told me herself.
This one time when everyone from her group came to visit, you accidentally served them orange juice even when you just told them it was tea.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Minori, what do idols usually like to drink? Coffee? Tea? Or something more exquisite that I've never heard of...?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Conversely, I could just serve water...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh... They're coming over as friends, so juice should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line:
That's true.
Then, how does orange juice sound?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Thank you all for coming over to visit today. Here, please have some tea.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, didn't we agree on orange juice?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? But you just said tea...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Hm? Oh no! Look at me! Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka and the others thought that she was just trying to be funny... But I felt a little embarrassed by what she did...)

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: What if I told you that your father was feeling very anxious that day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? I knew he was home since he had a day off, but I didn't see him at all.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Your father was so busy preparing himself to greet Haruka and the others.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Even though he was off that day, he put on his suit and practiced saying, “Please take good care of my daughter.”

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line:
Wh-What's wrong with that?
I was just trying to be polite. You know, as her parent?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: But he became so focused on practicing that they all left before he could even say anything to them.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: No, I just realized that being too formal would make things incredibly awkward.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I had no idea about any of that...
Thank goodness he decided against it.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I guess you're both quite careless...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother & Father
rows.Line:
Tell your father that.
Tell your mother that.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Brother
rows.Line:
Huh? You guys are all still here...?
Also, Minori, your show's in a few days. Shouldn't you ice that thing like now?
